subject: Post-call readout & pilot kickoff plan — Aureline Tech
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@aurelinetech.com>, Priya Rao <priya.rao@aurelinetech.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call readout & pilot kickoff plan — Aureline Tech

Hi Samir / Priya — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick written recap so we have alignment and clear next steps to start the pilot.

Summary of pain & goals
- Pain: high-volume, domain-specific summarization errors in your clinical notes pipeline; current infra spikes latency >700ms at peak which impacts downstream workflows.
- Primary goal: reduce P95 latency to <250ms for the summarization path while maintaining >=92% label agreement on our prompt eval set.
- Secondary goal: cost target of <$0.02 per 1k tokens processed in steady state.

Proposed pilot (three-week):
- Scope: inference evaluation on a 3-week sample (~50k tokens/day) using Redwood hosted dedicated pool (initially 2x A100-equivalent).
- Success metrics: P95 latency <250ms; prompt-eval agreement >=92% vs your gold set; end-to-end cost estimate and ops playbook delivered.
- Deliverables: pilot-charter-draft.pdf (attached), prompt-eval set (we will share), access checklist (attached).

Owners & roles
- Aureline: Samir (project lead), Priya (data & eval owner) — provide sample prompts, gold labels, and a short IAM list for test accounts.
- Redwood: Evelyn (engagement lead), Ben (serving/runtime ops), Neha (security & access).

Immediate access/setup asks (what we need from you by 9/17):
1) S3 read-only path with 3 days of sample docs + sample prompt/eval CSV (or share a drive link).
2) List of AWS IAM principals (emails) for test service accounts.
3) Point-of-contact for security questionnaire (SOC2 items).

Timeline (proposed)
- 9/17: access & data delivered
- 9/20: infra provisioned & initial ingest run
- 9/21–9/30: prompt-eval runs + latency testing
- 10/1: pilot readout (metrics, costs, next-steps)

Questions / open items from the call
- Confirm whether profiles need HIPAA-minimum handling or full BAAs (Samir — you flagged PHI concerns).
- Cost model: we offered a pilot estimate; you requested a firm delta if we switch to quantized model variants.

Next steps (action owners)
- Samir: confirm PHI handling and send sample data link + IAM list by 9/17.
- Priya: share the evaluation CSV (10–20 example prompts) by 9/17.
- Neha: we will circle on SOC2 excerpt — can you share contact for initial question list?
- Ben/Evelyn: we'll provision a staging pool and circulate access tokens once IAM list is received.

Attachments: pilot-charter-draft.pdf, access-checklist.xlsx

Thanks — I’ll send a calendar invite for the kickoff once we confirm 9/17 data delivery.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Engagement Lead, Redwood Inference
Evelyn.Hart@redwood.com
(Attachment: pilot-charter-draft.pdf; access-checklist.xlsx)

From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@aurelinetech.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya.rao@aurelinetech.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 17:03:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call readout & pilot kickoff plan — Aureline Tech

Thanks Evelyn — this is great, appreciate the clear next steps. A couple quick clarifications:

1) PHI: we operate under a minimal-PHI model for this dataset but will need a BAA for production. For the pilot, we can proceed under a scoping agreement but I will confirm with our legal/security team.
2) SOC2: I’m attaching a short vendor questionnaire (vendor-questionnaire.xlsx) — can you point me to who on your team will own answers?
3) Cost: can you include a short note on expected cost delta if you run 16-bit quantized variants vs baseline FP16? We want a quick ballpark before we lock infra.

We’ll aim to deliver sample prompt CSV and a short S3 path by 9/17 EOD. Priya will follow up with the eval set.

— Samir
Samir Patel
Head of ML Ops, Aureline Tech
samir.patel@aurelinetech.com
(Attachment: vendor-questionnaire.xlsx)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 09:10:45 -0700
Subject: Internal: Aureline pilot — infra & security prep

Evy / Neha — quick internal note after Samir’s confirmation.

Infra ops proposal (short):
- Provision dedicated pool: start with 2x A100-equivalent, with autoscale up to 4 under load. Configure continuous batching with max latency window 120ms to keep P95 goal.
- Try an FP16 baseline; run a quantized int8 variant in parallel for cost delta measurement (we can snapshot the KV cache and compare output quality on the eval set).

Security & compliance:
- Neha: can you prepare a SOC2 excerpt (system controls + network config) and a short checklist for the pilot (no BAA required for initial stage). Also prepare the minimal logging retention we will offer for Aureline.

Action items: 
- Ben: build the pilot infra blueprint and share runbook by EOD 9/17.
- Neha: prepare SOC2 excerpt & reach out to Samir’s contact (ask for their security POC).
- Markus: confirm resource quotas and schedule a short maintenance window for kernel tuning (target 9/20 morning).

I’ll draft the canary rollout steps (model variant fallback) and attach to the runbook.

Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@aurelinetech.com>, Priya Rao <priya.rao@aurelinetech.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Finalized kickoff & calendar — Aureline Tech pilot (starts 9/20)

Hi all — thanks for the quick replies. Updated plan and confirmations below; I’m locking the kickoff for Monday 9/20 morning (09:30 PT) — calendar invite attached.

Final decisions
- Pilot start: 2026-09-20 (initial provisioning on 9/19 evening).
- Infra: 2x A100-equivalent to start, autoscale to 4; run FP16 baseline + parallel quantized run for cost/quality comparison.
- Success metrics: P95 <250ms, prompt-eval agreement >=92%.

What Aureline will deliver by 9/17 EOD:
- S3 link to sample docs + eval CSV (Samir)
- IAM list for test principals (Samir)
- Security POC name/email for SOC2 questions (Samir)

What Redwood will deliver:
- Provisioning & runbook (Ben) by 9/17 EOD
- SOC2 excerpt & security checklist (Neha) by 9/17
- Pilot-charter updated with final scope (Evelyn) and shared drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C4D5E6

Next meeting: kickoff 9/20 09:30 PT (30m) — invited. After that, daily check-ins Mon/Wed during pilot unless issues surface.

Open items for the kickoff:
- Confirm whether we need a temporary BAA for any pilot data beyond minimal-PHI (Samir to confirm).
- Cost note: we’ll include a separate short note on quantization delta prior to provisioning; Ben will attach numbers.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this started.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Engagement Lead, Redwood Inference
Evelyn.Hart@redwood.com
(Attachments: pilot-charter-draft.pdf; access-checklist.xlsx; calendar invite)
